fields.description: Schedule-level line, e.g. 'Sale of Main Product - Sugar'
fields.label: Section Name

fields.description: Summary-sheet bucket this section rolls into, e.g. 'Revenue from operations'. Use the exact same text across multiple sections to combine them into one Summary line.
fields.label: Summary Group

fields.description: Label for this Summary Group's total row in the Detailed view, e.g. 'Total Of Revenue from operations'. Set it on the first section of the group. Leave blank to skip showing a total row for this group.
fields.label: Detailed Total Label

fields.description: If checked, this group's Detailed total row shows the running sum of this group plus every earlier Summary Group of the same Report Type, instead of just this group's own sections. Set it on the first section of the group. Example: tick this on 'Other Income' (with label 'Total Revenue') to get Revenue from operations + Other Income.
fields.label: Cumulative Total
